meta.title: Plugin market recommender
meta.description: Adds a Recommend tab to the Plugins page: type one sentence about what you want, and it ranks matching plugins from this profile's configured plugin indexes, the community dshmarket catalog, and the optional plugins built into this installation, each card carrying its install source, current status, and an install or enable button. It also adds a recommend_plugin tool so an agent checks the market before writing a new plugin. Catalogs are read and cached over the network; installing and enabling happen only when you press the button.
